title: fix(objectql): the nested-relation condition refusal prints its route inside the client cap
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVpEmthvkRbuHGjC6oSQZvd)_
Fixes #27351

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none (kind `none`, no narrowing arm; no `skills/**` file touched)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:数据查询在 `where` 里拒收嵌套关联条件(第二层关联、带点的键、空对象、未声明的键、未注册的关联对象)时,报错文字改为"位置 + 简短原因 + 该怎么写 + 未执行 + 补充原因";两类拒收的开头只列条件里的第一个键并计数其余键。
- 为什么改:客户端只读报错前 500 字符;原先"该怎么写"排在"未执行"之后,字段名稍长就被截掉(第二层关联、带点的键在普通字段名下就看不到 `$in` 写法);长名字下 #27350 的无运算符对象拒收也仍有 6 行被截。
- 风险与回滚:只改报错文案的顺序和措辞,拒收范围、错误码 `INVALID_FILTER`、状态 400、500 字符截断都不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/relation-filter-lowering.ts`(`relationConditionRefusalMessage` 五个分支与 `describeKeys`)、`packages/objectql/src/no-operator-object-door.ts`(`describeObject`)、`packages/objectql/src/relation-condition-prescription-cap.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/relation-condition-prescription-cap.test.ts src/no-operator-object-prescription-cap.test.ts`,预期 2 个文件 20/20 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/objectql/src/relation-filter-lowering.ts`, `relationConditionRefusalMessage`: every reason now reads **head, short reason, route, then "The filter was NOT applied." and any reasoning**, so the route sits inside the 499 characters a client reads (`CLIENT_MESSAGE_MAX`, `@objectstack/types`, unchanged).

- **second-level**: `…, and 'KEY' holds a condition of its own: one level only. Read 'TARGET' with { "KEY": { … } }, then match its ids: ROUTE. The filter was NOT applied. 'KEY' is itself a TYPE field of the related object 'TARGET'.`
- **dotted-key**, **empty**, **undeclared-key**, **unregistered-target**: the route moved ahead of "NOT applied"; the reason sentence is unchanged.
- **The head names the column after the path by its type** (`at PATH, beneath the lookup field`): the head already names the field twice (`filter on 'FIELD' … at PATH.FIELD`). The route names the field only in its spelling (`then match its ids:`, `Match ids you hold:`, `or test for a value:`).
- **The multi-valued ids route** reads `an $or of { "FIELD": { "$contains": ID } }, one per id` (was `{ "FIELD": { "$contains": ID } } for one id, an $or of those for several`). `idsRoute` is shared, so the cap refusal (`relationFilterCapError`) prints the same spelling.
- **The shared heads name the first key and count the rest**: `describeKeys` here and `describeObject` in `no-operator-object-door.ts` (`keys "region", and 2 more`, was three keys listed). This closes the residue PR #27350 recorded on the no-operator-object refusal's stress fixture, which the triage ruling asked to be measured in this PR.
- Unchanged: the set of filters refused, `INVALID_FILTER` / 400, the envelope, the cap and the truncation, and the phrases other packages' tests read (`names no field of the related object`, `'KEY' is itself a lookup field of the related object 'X'`, `is a dotted path: the condition reaches one level only`, `{ "FIELD": { "$null": false } }`, `{ "FIELD": { "$in": [ID, …] } }`, `The filter was NOT applied.`).

## Tests

- New `relation-condition-prescription-cap.test.ts`: for each of the five reasons, on three fixtures, the refusal is read through `mapDataError` as a client reads it. The test requires `400` + `INVALID_FILTER`, the whole route in the client text, the route ahead of "NOT applied", and the route ending by the fixture's limit. The card's fixture (21-character object and field, 16-character target, three keys, nested `$and` / `$or`) has a limit of 459, which is 40 inside the cut. The stress fixture (27-character object and target, 32-character field, four 11- to 15-character keys, three-deep path), single- and multi-valued, has a limit of 499. That makes 15 tests.
- `no-operator-object-prescription-cap.test.ts` gains a stress block: every kind at every position it is refused, on a 27-character object and target, 32-character fields, a four-key object, and `aggregations[12].filter` with a three-deep path. The route must end by 499.
- Three in-surface pins were updated for the head wording. `engine-nested-relation-lowering.test.ts` now asserts `at PATH, beneath the (lookup|tree) field, and `. `protocol-explicit-filter-field-gate.test.ts` now asserts `… at where.owner_id, beneath the lookup field,`.

<details><summary>Package runs (head 2eb99b8ab, after merging origin/main f57eddcf0)</summary>

- Under the verify lock: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/objectql...' build`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck` OK), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: Test Files 484 passed (484), Tests 9104 passed (9104). Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/data-nested-object-door.test.ts src/data-no-operator-object-door.test.ts`: 10 passed, 20 skipped (the live PostgreSQL / MySQL cells, with no env here; the SQLite cell ran, and it asserts the second-level, empty and undeclared words and routes on the REST body). The lock printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config packages/objectql`: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (fix committed first; each leg through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

1. `relationConditionRefusalMessage`'s head-and-switch span was replaced by its `cf218eed1` text, which restores the old order. The anchor went from 1 to 0 and the blob from `2f1d2a495ff1` to `b8031a3df929`. Result: `relation-condition-prescription-cap.test.ts` had 15 failed (15). Examples: "the route ends at 496; the limit is 459" (the card's second-level reason); `expected 303 to be greater than 420` (the card's unregistered reason, where "NOT applied" comes before the route); "the client text holds the whole route" on the stress rows. After restore the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
2. `describeObject` was set back to listing three keys. The anchor went from 1 to 0 and the blob from `c06bf275a4ef` to `4584cc487e38`. Result: `no-operator-object-prescription-cap.test.ts` had 1 failed | 4 passed (5): the stress block, where the client text no longer holds `Move the condition to 'where', or f…`. After restore the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

The tests import the subject by a relative `src` path, so no `dist` build sits between the test and the edit.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Thin margin on the extreme rows.** On the no-operator stress fixture the single-valued lookup at `aggregations[12].filter` ends at 498, 1 inside the cut. On the relation stress fixture the multi-valued rows end at 477–479. The card-sized fixtures keep 40+ characters of margin, and so does #27350's own fixture. A longer fixture still could be cut. The next lever would be the per-kind route words, not the head, which now names one key.
- **The cap refusal's multi-valued route spelling changed** because `idsRoute` is shared. The meaning is the same, and the cap test's `{ "owners": { "$contains": ID } }` pin still holds.
